_comment: Inputs hand-authored; every expect is written by the independent Python oracle (python3 🐍️.py --write), never by the TypeScript implementation.

decisions.name: calm: plenty available, nothing to do
guard by available memory below the guard line
guard by swap that worked while below the resume line
no guard when swap is below the active rate
guard by OS pressure warn below the resume line
OS warn above the resume line stays calm
danger by available memory: two cancels then a suspend
danger by OS critical with plenty available
keepRunning: the only running subject is never suspended
keepRunning 2 keeps the two most expensive running
keepRunning 0 may suspend every subject
order: rank, then elapsed, then megabytes descending, then pid
per-tick maximum of suspends
per-tick maximum of cancels
overdue suspended subject is cancelled below calm
overdue subject that cannot cancel is resumed
overdue subject that cannot cancel is resumed even when calm
overdue cancellable subject is not cancelled when calm
overdue cancels are limited by the per-tick maximum
suspended subjects are cancelled first in danger
overdue cancel counts toward the freed megabytes in danger
calm hysteresis: second calm tick resumes nothing
calm hysteresis: third calm tick resumes the most expensive suspended subject, one per tick
calm count restarts after a guard tick
resume is blocked below the resume line
resume allowed exactly at the resume line
clamp minimum on a 4 GB host
4 GB host: available between the guard line and the resume line is calm without signals
clamp maximum on a 128 GB host
128 GB host: resume line is its share
unknown swap rate never counts as worked
empty subjects at danger
already suspended subjects cover the deficit
subjects that cannot suspend are skipped
danger without cancellable subjects only suspends
danger stops cancelling once the deficit is covered
calm tick with nothing suspended
custom calmTicks 1 resumes at once

classifications.name: local unit below a root, an unrelated rustc is not a subject
remote unit is a rustc below the remote-execution work directory
never patterns: the sidecar and the replica are no subjects, the Ready stage wrapper below the sidecar is
a protected path excludes the process and every descendant
within keeps only descendants of the given pid, never the pid itself
megabytes: a subject holds itself and every process whose nearest subject it is
pool child and warm deriver, the pool puller is never a subject
kinds: farm worker, heavy question, test, slice worker, stage with ranks and actions
a stopped subject carries the seconds since its recorded suspension
owner label cuts the prefixes, keeps the base name and at most 96 characters
the native build scheduler is a root
the first matching kind wins: a heavy question run by bun test is a heavy question
a process outside every root is no subject even when its command is a kind
a pid reused with another start text is another subject id
injected tables replace the authored ones
